meta.strapline: Find your child's club, close to home.
meta.description: A free directory of kids' sports clubs in Dubai, with the facts first.

common.demoBanner: Demo data. Every club, person and number here is made up.
common.notFound: We could not find that page.

home.title: Find your child's club, close to home.
home.intro: Every club near you, with the ages, days, area and price first. Clubs list for free, so you see the clubs near you, not just the ones paying.
home.areaHint: We are live in these areas.
home.comingSoonIntro: We are not live here yet. Join the waitlist and we will tell you when we are.
home.clubPrompt: Can't see your club? Add it in two minutes.

results.title: {sport} clubs near {area}
results.count: {count, plural, =0 {No clubs match} one {# club listed} other {# clubs listed}}
results.order: Ordered by distance from {area}, then by name. Paid placement never changes this order.
results.featuredNote: Paid placement. It does not change the order of the list below.
results.emptyBody: We have not listed a club that matches all of that in {area}. Here is what is listed nearby.
results.suggestTitle: Know a club we are missing?
results.suggestBody: Tell us its name and we will ask them to list for free.
results.suggestNote: Anything that helps us find it
results.suggestThanks: Thanks. We will get in touch with the club.

club.noPhotos: This club has not added photos yet.
club.noDescription: The club has not written a description yet.
club.signInToEnquire: Sign in to send an enquiry or save this club.
club.reportSent: Thanks. The photo is hidden while we review it.
club.reportSignIn: Sign in to report a photo.

reasons.no_consent: I did not give consent for this photo

club.replyIn: Usually replies within {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
club.pending: Waiting for approval. Parents cannot see this listing yet.

waitlist.title: {area} is coming soon
waitlist.body: We are not live in {area} yet, so we will not show an empty list. Join the waitlist and we will email you once clubs are listed.
waitlist.joined: You are on the waitlist for {area}.

enquiry.title: Send an enquiry to {club}
enquiry.intro: Short and simple. The club replies to you directly.
enquiry.name: Your name
enquiry.addChildHint: Add children on your family page to pick them here.
enquiry.messageHint: For example: Is there space on Mondays this term?
enquiry.consent: I agree that {club} will see my name, email, phone and my child's nickname and age.
enquiry.replyBody: {club} usually replies within {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}, by email or phone.
enquiry.trackBody: You can see the status on your family page.

family.title: Your family
family.childrenIntro: A nickname and birth year are all we keep.
family.nicknameHint: A nickname is enough. We do not ask for full names.
family.noSaved: No saved clubs yet. Save a club from its page.
family.weekIntro: The days and times from your saved clubs, for the ages of your children.
family.weekEmpty: Save a club to see its sessions here.

auth.name: Your name
auth.magicSent: Check your email for a sign-in link.
auth.failed: That email and password did not match.
auth.checkEmail: Account created. Check your email to confirm, then sign in.
auth.whyAccount: You can browse without an account. You need one to send an enquiry or save clubs.

dashboard.title: Club dashboard
dashboard.intro: Visibility is free for every club. Manage incoming parent demand for {name}.

clubArea.title: Your club
clubArea.intro: Listing is free for every club, academy or community club, and always will be.
clubArea.addPrompt: Can't see your club? Add it in two minutes.
clubArea.noClubs: You do not manage a club yet.
clubArea.signUpClub: Create a club account to add your listing.

onboard.title: Add your club
onboard.intro: Two minutes. You can add photos and more sessions afterwards.
onboard.claimNote: We check claims by hand before you can edit a listing.
onboard.claimSent: Thanks. We will check your claim and email you.
onboard.claimNone: No listed club matches that name.
onboard.name: Club name
onboard.typeHint: Type is for information only. It never changes where you appear.
onboard.created: Your club is added. We approve new listings by hand, usually within two working days.

editor.title: Edit {name}
editor.intro: This is exactly what parents see, in the same order.
editor.descriptionHint: Facts already show above this. Use this for anything else parents should know.
editor.savedChanges: Saved. Parents see the changes now.

photos.title: Photos for {name}
photos.rules: Three rules: confirm you hold parental consent for every photo; parents can report a photo and it comes down while we review it; never put a child's name in a caption.
photos.fileHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB.
photos.altHint: For people who cannot see it. Required.
photos.caption: Caption
photos.captionWarning: This caption may name a child: {words}. Please remove names before uploading.
photos.consent: I confirm the club holds parental consent for every child in this photo.

licence.title: Trade licence for {name}
licence.intro: Send us your trade licence. We check it by hand. The Licence verified badge shows only after we approve it, and it comes off when the licence expires.
licence.authorityHint: Write it as it appears on the licence.
licence.documentHint: PDF, JPEG or PNG, up to 10 MB.
licence.submitted: Licence sent. We will check it and email you.

states.expired: Expired. Send a new licence to show the badge again.

demand.title: Demand for {name}
demand.commentaryZero: No parents have viewed your listing yet. Listings with photos and clear session times tend to get more views.
demand.commentary: Parents viewed your club {views, plural, one {# time} other {# times}}, and {enquiries, plural, =0 {nobody has sent an enquiry yet} one {# enquiry came in} other {# enquiries came in}}.
demand.previous: In the 30 days before that: {views} views and {enquiries} enquiries.
demand.upgradeTitle: You are getting more enquiries than most clubs can field by hand
demand.upgradeBody: Here is what the paid tools will do. Your listing stays free either way.

upgrade.title: Paid tools for clubs
upgrade.intro: Listing is free for every club, always. Paid tools are for clubs whose enquiries have become work.
upgrade.what: What the paid tools will help with
upgrade.items: Managing enquiries in one place|Promoting offers such as a trial session|Reaching parents in a new area
upgrade.neverItems: Move you higher in the list|Hide other clubs|Change your terms because of your club type
upgrade.pricing: One published price list, set by club size. Not available yet; there is nothing to buy today.
upgrade.notAvailable: Paid tools are not available yet.

admin.title: Admin
admin.coverageRule: The second cluster opens when 25% of identified first-cluster clubs are listed. That is {needed} clubs. Opening is a manual decision.
admin.coverageMet: Threshold reached. Ready to decide on opening the next cluster.

errors.photoConsent: Confirm you hold parental consent before uploading.

errors.clubName: Enter a name between 2 and 80 characters.

errors.ageRange: The oldest age must be the same as or above the youngest.
errors.altText: Describe the photo in 3 to 200 characters.
errors.caption: Keep the caption under 140 characters.
errors.fileType: That file type is not allowed.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.notAllowed: You do not have access to that.

styleguide.intro: Tokens and components. Placeholder logo and illustrations are marked as such.
styleguide.fieldHint: A nickname is enough. We do not ask for full names.
styleguide.checkbox: I confirm the club holds parental consent for this photo.
styleguide.noticeInfo: Live in Arabian Ranches, the Meadows and the Springs.
